find_peaks — ONED signal op

• Data kinds: signal → indices

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.find_peaks(x, height=None, distance=None) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import dsp; dsp.find_peaks(x, height=None, distance=None), registry से लेना हो तो ops1d.get("find_peaks"))

उपयोग

peak के index (scipy.signal.find_peaks) — impact / defect echo।
